verdict.rationale: Published storage pricing is a fair question for a cloud storage product, but the evidence pack contains no public pricing page, per-plan storage quotas, per-user prices, or documentation of what happens at the storage cap. The only related items are old community anecdotes about free-tier limits: a 250MB max file size and 10GB/month bandwidth. These are not official published pricing and do not describe storage quotas or cap behavior.
